title: Contour (non-TWDB) effective-zone validation against USACE CWMS stage-area curves: preregistration
purpose: Test whether zones.reference_zones_from_shares + zones.effective_zones, fed with the manifest reference shares of the surveyed surface by depth band (candidates.json referenceZones, from rasterised state/agency contour products) predicts the share of the reference-pool surface that is dry at lower pools, against the exact stage-area (elevation-area) curve published in USACE CWMS. Also decide which sources/lakes have a documented survey reference pool (VERIFIED) for the effective-zone gate.

dataBinding.note: Facts were collected before this file was frozen; no share-vs-curve comparison existed.

truth.source: USACE CWMS Data API (https://cwms-data.usace.army.mil/cwms-data/ratings/<id>?office=<office>), Elev;Area (ft;acre) or Stage;Area ratings, fetched 2026-10-13; points in contour2_curves.csv. Stage curves (MVP Gull/Leech/Winnibigoshish): elevation = stage + CWMS location 'elevation' (gauge zero; 1100.0, 1200.0, 1200.0 ft NGVD29), an ASSUMPTION flagged on those lakes.
truth.versionChoice: if a rating has several effective-date versions: the version whose effective year is nearest to the contour survey year (ties: later); latest when the survey year is unknown
truth.interpolation: linear in elevation; below the curve's lowest elevation the area is 0 only if the first point's area is 0, otherwise UNDEFINED and that lake-level (or band) is excluded; above the highest elevation excluded
truth.independence: The predictor shares come from contour products (sonar/map surveys); the truth is an operator curve (design-era or sediment-resurvey tables). They are independent products, unlike the TWDB S1 predictor, BUT lineage can overlap (e.g. a Corps curve may derive from the same survey) and the curve may predate or postdate the contour survey (sedimentation); curve effective dates and survey years are reported per lake. This is the only test; there is no circular predictor in this study.

referenceVerification.rule: A lake is VERIFIED only if ALL hold. R1: a source statement (dataset metadata, the agency's per-lake map/sheet, or a per-contour Elevation attribute that equals pool - depth with range <= 0.5 ft inside the lake) says the contour depths are measured from a stated numeric water-surface ELEVATION (pool). R2: that elevation is within 0.25 ft (contract SIGMA_POOL['high']) of the Sector directory fullPoolFt (no rounding allowance). R3: the directory pool datum is NGVD29 or NAVD88 (recorded, not LOCAL/None) and any datum the source itself states is the same. R4: the source's documentation is not self-contradictory. Otherwise UNVERIFIED, with the missing evidence listed. 'Contours are depth at the date of survey' with no water level is UNVERIFIED.

referenceVerification.excludedFromPassFail: UNVERIFIED lakes never enter pass/fail; they appear only in the informational 'assumed pool' runs (pRef = source-stated pool if the source has one with constant implied elevation, else directory fullPoolFt).

levels.rule: pool_low = pRef - d; shift passed to effective_zones = -d. A lake-level is included only if the truth curve is defined at pRef-d (dry share) -- see truth.interpolation; a band is scored only if its lowest needed elevation is within the curve. Excluded lake-levels are listed, never imputed.

sigma.graded: production sigma = sqrt(0.25^2 + 0.1^2 + 0.1^2) = 0.287 ft for every lake (sigma_pool 'high' 0.25, sigma_level DIRECT_OPERATOR_POOL 0.1, sigma_datum SAME_DATUM 0.1); the same value is used for assumed-pool lakes (pool uncertainty there is in truth larger; informational)

C1.shares: candidates.json referenceZones.cumulative (keys 3.0/6.0/10.0 -> lt3/lt6/lt10) as frozen in contour2_lake_facts.json; only supported edges exist
C1.build: zones.reference_zones_from_shares(shares, interval, coverage, tier, source, reference_verified=True)  (flag forced on so UNVERIFIED lakes can be computed informationally)

predictors.baseline: informational: leave-one-lake-out mean dry share at the same d over the other lakes of the same group

metrics.primaryQuantity: dry share of the reference-pool surface (effective_zones()['shares']['dry'], point estimate = midpoint of (lo, hi)); if the engine WITHHOLDS dry (bound wider than contract MAX_PUBLISHED_BOUND_WIDTH = 0.25) the lake-level is 'withheld' and not scored for accuracy
metrics.M3_boundsCoverage: fraction of published lake-levels with lo-0.0005 <= truth <= hi+0.0005
metrics.M4_boundsWidth: median and p90 of (hi-lo) over published lake-levels
metrics.M5_rank: pooled Spearman midpoint vs truth over published graded lake-levels (reported per level across lakes, not gating)
metrics.bands: under3/threeToSix/sixToTen/deeper: same M1/M3 where published, reported, not gating

diagnostics.D1_shareCheckAtPRef: for each supported edge e: S_contour(e) - S_curve(e) with S_curve(e) = (A(pRef)-A(pRef-e))/A(pRef); reported, does not gate
diagnostics.D2_impliedPool: grid P in pRef-6..pRef+6 step 0.1; P* minimises sum_e (S_contour(e) - S_curve_P(e))^2 over supported edges; report P*-pRef. INFORMATIONAL ONLY: it shows how far the survey level may be from the assumed pool; it never changes a status, a level or a threshold

thresholds.T6_why: Different from TWDB (where dry was always published): coarse intervals (5/10 ft) leave only the 10 ft edge so dry bounds are [0, S10] and are withheld by the engine's own 0.25 width rule. A lake that is withheld at most levels cannot be 'passed'; the withhold is the engine's correct refusal, not an accuracy failure, so accuracy metrics use published levels and T6 gates the usefulness.
thresholds.perLakePass: VERIFIED and curve exists and published levels >= 3 and own MAE <= T1, max <= T2, coverage >= T3, median width <= T4 and publishRate >= T6. validation.passed = true only then; false if VERIFIED+curve and any fails; null if UNVERIFIED or no curve (including 'insufficient published levels' = false for VERIFIED lakes).
thresholds.pooledPass: over GRADED lakes: T1..T6 all met (T5 needs >= 3 published points); reported only, not required for a lake's own passed flag

enableRecommendationRule: effectiveZones may be enabled for a lake only if VERIFIED and validation.passed is true; a result on assumed-pool lakes is NOT an enable recommendation.
analysisRules: Thresholds, levels, rule, roster, predictor and metrics are frozen; nothing changes after results.
Every included lake-level is reported, withheld ones included.
The compute script (research/depth/contour2_validate.py) verifies this file's hash AND the data files' hashes and refuses to run on a mismatch.
Small n is stated; no lake is added or dropped after results.
disclosure: Before freezing the author had read: the manifest reference shares and intervals of all 94 lakes; the source pool statements (ODNR PDFs, KARS PhysicalLakeData, NE/ND/OK contour Elevation attributes) and their comparison with directory pools (so the status outcomes above are known to the author; the R2 tolerance was kept at 0.25 ft with no rounding allowance deliberately to avoid post-hoc relaxation); the CWMS rating endpoints (minimum/maximum elevation, datum, version dates). No share-vs-curve comparison, no A(pRef), and no effective-zone prediction had been computed.
knownCaveats: Shares are of the SURVEYED surface at the survey pool (coverage may be < 1); the curve gives whole-lake area. Partial coverage biases shares (reported in facts coverage).
Curves may predate the contour survey; sedimentation changes shallow area.
CWMS curve datum 'OTHER' (NWDM Step templates) and Stage curves (MN) carry assumed datums.
Withholding follows the engine's 0.25 bound-width rule.
